newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Banco de Colombia sees '96 profit surge.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Colombia sees '96 profit surge.

text.p: Banco de Colombia expects its net profit to increase to $78 million this year, up from $54 million in 1995, the bank's president said.

Federico Rengifo gave no details, but he made the forecast of a $24 million jump in net profit in remarks to Reuters on the sidelines of a shareholders meeting where Banco de Colombia increased its annual dividend to 20 pesos per share, up from 15 pesos last year.

The bank, Colombia's second largest in terms of assets and one of the most actively traded shares on Colombia's leading stock exchanges, will pay out 21.3 billion pesos ($20.7 million) in dividends this year.
